limitations.note: The agent fixed the shift direction but compared the newly shifted window instead of the previous registered window, asserting match one clock early, and added a sample-count gate that suppresses matches using reset-initialized history.

The test expected match on the edge that sampled the ninth bit and reset before checking the following edge, so its exhaustive window sweep validated the rewrite's timing rather than the required registered timing.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected because its cleanup used a disallowed command, so the agent had to resubmit the test with a different cleanup method.
